papers.title: Crater Scaling Relationships for Gas Impingement on Planetary Regolith
papers.abstract: Plume-surface interaction (PSI) effects remains a major uncertainty for operations on regolith-covered planetary bodies. Although spacecraft exhaust can erode surfaces, form craters, and accelerate ejecta, existing PSI relationships are largely derived for scenario-specific lunar and Martian landing conditions and are not yet reliably generalizable. Resolving this problem is important not only for spacecraft safety, but also because controlled thruster interactions could provide an active geotechnical experiment during asteroid reconnaissance. Measurements of thruster-formed craters and ejecta may constrain regolith density, strength, porosity, and particle properties that are otherwise difficult to determine remotely. Such information is particularly relevant to planetary defense, where uncertainty in near-surface properties can strongly affect the outcome of kinetic-impact mitigation and the interpretation of momentum transfer. We investigate gas-driven excavation using near-vacuum, pulsed-N$_2$ experiments in a cohesionless asteroid regolith analog and comparisons with a low-gravity drop-tower experiment and historical chemical-thruster tests. We adapt projectile-cratering $π$-scaling, and find that these relationships can describe gas crater volume as a function of gas, target, gravity, and nozzle properties. A common gravity-regime relationship describes the laboratory data and is consistent with an experimental low-gravity result. Generalizing the $π$-scaling relationship for cohesive targets shows consistency with Apollo-era chemical-thruster cases. These results provide a framework for using spacecraft thrusters as active geotechnical tools during small-body reconnaissance.

digest.summaryZh: 该研究通过近真空脉冲气体实验，将撞击成坑的无量纲标度关系扩展到推进器喷流侵蚀，尝试用坑体积反推小天体表层性质。它属于行星地质与航天操作研究，与AI芯片和LLM执行无直接关系。
digest.motivationZh: 推进器喷流会侵蚀星体表面并抛射颗粒，现有关系多限月球或火星特定场景。不同重力、靶材和喷嘴条件下缺少可推广的气体成坑描述。可靠标度既影响着陆操作，也可能使推进器成为探测表层密度和强度的工具。研究对象是喷流与颗粒表面的相互作用，队列硬件标签与AI体系结构方向不符。
digest.methodZh: 将弹丸成坑的π标度用于气体挖掘，以气体、靶材、重力和喷嘴参数描述坑体积。近真空脉冲氮气实验。与低重力落塔结果比较。扩展至有黏聚力靶材并对照历史推进器试验。使用气体冲击与颗粒材料实验装置，不涉及处理器、神经网络加速或存储架构。用共同标度框架连接实验室气体成坑和历史化学推进器结果，探索主动地质测量用途。
digest.experimentsZh: 无黏聚小行星风化层类比材料的脉冲N₂实验，另对照低重力和阿波罗时代试验。参考低重力落塔数据和历史化学推进器案例，而非计算系统性能基线。摘要报告共同重力域关系可描述实验室数据，并与低重力结果一致；黏聚靶材扩展与历史案例相符，未给统一误差或精度数值。证据覆盖的实验条件有限，标度一致性不等于已验证全部星体材料；没有AI计算性能结论。

papers.abstract: We searched within the first data release of the Euclid Wide Survey (~1900 deg^2) for resolved stellar systems between distances from 10 kpc and several Mpc, using an isochrone filtering technique. We detect 15 systems that have never been resolved into stars before. Five are new discoveries, three in the Milky Way halo and two beyond the Local Group. The remaining ten are dwarf galaxies that were previously catalogued as unresolved sources in shallower ground-based surveys and lack reliable distance measures. We measured distance moduli for all 15 systems, and half-light radii, ellipticities, position angles, absolute magnitudes, and stellar masses for 14 of them. In the Milky Way halo, Ursa Minor II, at ~20 kpc, has Mv ~ +2.0 and a stellar mass of ~40 Msun, and is one of the least luminous stellar systems known. Fornax 7 is located near the tidal limit of the Fornax dwarf spheroidal galaxy and may be physically associated with it. Eridanus V lies at ~165 kpc and has a stellar mass of ~550 Msun, which places it in the region of the size-luminosity plane where globular clusters and ultra-faint dwarf galaxies overlap. Beyond the Local Group, the 12 dwarf galaxies lie at distances of 3--5.5 Mpc. Three of them reach or exceed a mean surface brightness within the half-light radius of mu_V~28 mag/arcsec^2, a regime in which almost no galaxies at these distances were previously known. Ten of them are candidate members of the M81 group: eight have three-dimensional distances from M81 smaller than or comparable to the radius of its zero-velocity surface, and two lie close to the peripheral member NGC 4236, one of which is a candidate satellite of this galaxy. These results demonstrate Euclid's transformative potential for low-surface-brightness science, enabling the study of an unprecedented range of environments from the MW halo out to the Local Volume within a single, homogeneous survey.

papers.title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
papers.abstract: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, $\texttt{llama.cpp}$'s K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At $1\%$ and $3.5\%$ perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are $5.7-31.4\%$ smaller than the best $\texttt{llama.cpp}$ format. A bit-exact $0.21$ mm$^2$ ASIC decoder unit ($1$ GHz, $7$ nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to $36\%$ and $38\%$ ($54\%$ and $44\%$ with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ needs $58-64\%$ less time and $53-57\%$ less energy per token than CPU $\texttt{llama.cpp}$, and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6$\times$ faster at $3.89$ bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).

digest.summaryZh: LazyWeights 在标准量化格式内塑造可压缩整数分布，以并行Huffman码存储权重，并在DRAM与L2之间按需解码。它联合量化、编码布局和硬件解码，面向边缘LLM的容量与带宽瓶颈。
digest.motivationZh: 边缘LLM受内存容量与带宽限制，固定宽度码没有利用量化整数的非均匀分布。软件熵解码可能抵消字节节省，先展开回DRAM也不能减少每token的内存流量。压缩只有在保持模型质量且以足够吞吐解码时，才能转化为实际推理收益。直接关联低比特表示、内存控制器到缓存的数据路径、解码单元与边缘架构，应优先深读。
digest.methodZh: 在部署格式中调整GPTQ量化步长以集中码分布，使用交错lane的无损Huffman布局，再由DRAM和L2间单元还原定宽码。格式保持的熵感知量化。每矩阵规范Huffman码与独立tile入口。硬件按带宽配置解码引擎，使下游GPU内核继续读取原格式。包含7nm ASIC解码器综合与ZCU102逐比特原型验证；Jetson上的含单元整机时间和能耗由实测twin与解码器/DRAM模型组合估算。将整数码选择、并行可解布局和内存层次解码位置共同设计，而非只压缩模型文件。
digest.experimentsZh: Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B、SmolLM-1.7B；4GB Nano与8GB Orin Nano Super；比较贪心及prompt-lookup推测模式。同困惑度预算内最小llama.cpp格式；Orin为CUDA基线，Nano因软件兼容限制采用CPU基线；固定宽度twin隔离解码单元贡献。在1%和3.5%困惑度预算内，编码模型比最优llama.cpp格式小5.7–31.4%。作者模型下Orin时间/能耗最高下降36%/38%，配推测为54%/44%；摘要报告0.21 mm²、1GHz、7nm解码单元。综合面积、FPGA位一致性与Jetson整机模型是不同证据层级；不是新ASIC装入Jetson后的直接实测。Nano对照为CPU，不能当同GPU内核加速；无损编码仍保留量化造成的质量损失。

papers.title: Beyond Compressing Everything: Contrastive Memory Learning for Selective Context Compression
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) advance toward increasingly long inputs, soft context compression offers a promising approach to efficient inference by converting long inputs into compact memory slots. Under limited memory budgets, effective context compression remains challenging because task-relevant evidence varies substantially across queries, ranging from localized evidence to multiple distant spans or information dispersed throughout the full document. Instead of compressing everything indiscriminately, we propose CoMem, a query-guided selective context compression framework that learns memory representations conditioned on both the document and the query. CoMem develops Contrastive Compressor Learning to achieve query-sensitive yet context-preserving memory representations. To inject a strong prior over query-dependent evidence distributions, we devise a same-context hard negative mining strategy by pairing a single document with multiple queries, requiring the compressor to selectively retain information according to each query's distinct evidence needs. To address the restricted information flow imposed by causal masking, we further enable bidirectional attention among memory slots. Experiments demonstrate that CoMem consistently outperforms existing context compression methods across compression ratios on question answering and RULER-NIAH benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/scar-on/CoMem.

papers.title: STEALTH: Steganographic Text Encoding Agnostic to Low-Level Tensor Hardware
papers.abstract: Provably secure linguistic steganography hides a message inside text sampled from a language model, so that without the key, a stegotext is computationally indistinguishable from an honest model sample. Nearly every such scheme assumes the receiver can recompute the sender's token probabilities exactly bit for bit. We show this assumption is fragile: across three model families, bit-exact schemes decode almost none of our messages once the receiver's floating-point precision, quantization, or GPU architecture differs from the sender's, or even when the receiver merely scores a text in parallel versus one token at a time, with the same model, precision, and hardware held fixed. We present STEALTH, a scheme built for exactly this setting. The sender draws each token with an exponential race driven by keyed pseudorandom noise, so a receiver's probability mismatch flips a token only when the race is close; a rateless spinal code, decoded by beam search, absorbs the resulting flips without the sender and receiver ever agreeing on a single distribution. We prove stegotexts remain indistinguishable from honest samples under this construction. Empirically, STEALTH decodes every message we sent for every receiver in the sender's model family, at every precision and quantization level, on smaller models, and on a different GPU architecture. STEALTH is even robust across different model families with separate vocabularies and tokenizers, decoding every message we tested. Our approach carries far more payload per token than prior robust schemes, and trained steganalyzers and a targeted statistical test both fail to distinguish its stegotexts from honest model output.

papers.title: SoScale: Second-Order Scale Search for FP4 Quantization
papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet accurate FP4 quantization remains challenging. Practical formats such as MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4 pair a 4-bit floating-point payload with block-wise or hierarchical scale codes, making accuracy highly sensitive to how each local distribution is scaled. Default maximum-absolute-value scaling preserves dynamic range, but can spend scarce FP4 levels on rarely occupied outlier regions and leave dense tensor values poorly resolved. Existing scale-search methods minimize local element-wise reconstruction error, optimizing tensor fidelity rather than layer-output fidelity. We propose SoScale, a second-order weight scale-code search method for hierarchical FP4 quantization. SoScale searches hardware-valid scale codes under a Hessian-aware layer reconstruction objective and couples this search with GPTQ-style error recovery, selecting scales by their impact on layer outputs. Across Qwen3 models, SoScale consistently reduces downstream quantization degradation under MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4.

papers.title: K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
papers.abstract: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion process.We propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.

papers.title: ProtoVis-Nav: Prototypical Visual Imagination for Visual-Spatial Aligned UAV Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision language navigation (VLN) is very challenging for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) since small errors in 3D motion prediction can lead to navigation errors and collisions. Unable to fathom execution outcomes in 3D environments, existing methods often struggle to predict accurate navigation waypoints from language instructions. To solve this, we introduce the Prototypical Visual Imagination framework, shortened as ProtoVis-Nav, which forces the model to imagine an outcome-associated local visual representation for the intended next UAV movement. Specifically, we predict feature prototypes and use their linear combination to estimate the visual feature of the target region. In this manner, the VLN model first imagines the local visual representation of the next intended location, and then uses predicted prototypes as context for generating the final action, promoting alignment between visual context and waypoint outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the ProtoVis-Nav framework and show substantial improvements over existing baselines.

digest.motivationZh: 无人机语言导航中的小位移误差会累计并导致碰撞，当前观测未必直接表征动作后的局部结果。全局未来帧预测可能忽略决定精细动作的局部区域，单纯航点损失也缺少视觉对齐信号。局部执行结果的表征可帮助动作选择，但必须用闭环导航任务检验。属于具身多模态趋势，对AI核心或内存架构没有直接优化，优先级低于量化和存储论文。
digest.methodZh: 预测多个视觉原型并线性组合为目标局部特征，再作为上下文引导航点动作输出。将下一三维位置投影到当前图像建立局部监督。原型视觉想象头形成紧凑局部特征。结合当前双视角、语言和状态生成导航航点。Qwen3VL-2B-Instruct骨干冻结，训练LoRA和新增头；实验主要是闭环仿真，未据本轮阅读报告部署芯片成本。从预测整帧转向与下一动作结果关联的局部原型，使视觉监督直接连接预期航点。
digest.experimentsZh: OpenUAV与HUGE-Bench障碍区域穿越任务，比较已见和未见场景。包含CMA、TravelUAV、NavFoM、LongFly与自有Base；应区分跨系统对比和同骨干变体。OpenUAV Test Seen Full表中，Base的SR为46.47、SPL为41.14，ProtoVis-Nav为50.78、44.68；这是该设置的结果，不推广为所有未见或真实飞行条件。仿真平台与实际飞行存在差异，局部想象预测错误仍可能产生不安全动作；没有真实部署可靠性或硬件节约结论。
